projects.title: Krishak Robot
projects.overview: **Overview:** Autonomous agricultural rover with a 6-DOF robotic arm built for precision field operations.
highlights: **Robotic arm platform:** Built a 6-DOF robotic arm on a 6-wheeled rover chassis, improving task precision by 30% and reducing labor costs by 20%.
**Task automation:** Implemented a finite state machine for automated scheduling, increasing efficiency by 40%.
**Autonomous weed detection:** Integrated computer vision and AI with 95% accuracy, reducing herbicide usage by 25%.

projects.title: Personality Prediction of Candidates
projects.overview: **Overview:** Machine learning project for personality prediction based on behavioural and skill analysis.
highlights: **Prediction model:** Built a machine learning model for personality prediction, improving hiring accuracy by 25%.
**Model optimization:** Improved performance with Python, data preprocessing, and feature engineering.
**Evaluation:** Achieved 92% accuracy on test datasets.

projects.title: Sustainable Smart Lighting
projects.overview: **Overview:** Adaptive highway lighting concept designed around energy harvesting and smarter power usage.
highlights: **Energy harvesting:** Designed a highway lighting system using piezoelectric transducers to reduce infrastructure energy costs.
**Power management:** Improved energy storage efficiency by 30% through a dedicated management system.
**Adaptive control:** Integrated motion sensors and microcontrollers to reduce energy waste by 40%.

experience.overview: **Overview:** Worked on ECU diagnostics and automotive validation projects for Nissan Motor Corporation and Marelli.
highlights: **CAN and UDS diagnostics:** Developed and implemented Controller Area Network (CAN) and Unified Diagnostic Services (UDS, ISO 14229) with ISO 15765 compliance.
**ODX and PDX integration:** Managed diagnostic data exchange formats and reduced processing time by 30%.
**OTX automation:** Automated ECU diagnostic workflows with OTX scripting, improving test efficiency by 40% and reducing manual intervention.
**Root cause analysis:** Resolved critical ECU software issues and supported faster software deployments.
**Technical documentation:** Authored documentation for Marelli's fan temperature control system, improving troubleshooting efficiency by 30%.

experience.overview: **Overview:** Worked on industrial IoT gateways, PLC integration, and real-time machine data acquisition.
highlights: **Industrial protocols:** Configured Profinet, Modbus TCP, RS485, and MQTT for IIoT gateways to improve machine-to-machine communication.
**Real-time integration:** Connected PLCs, energy meters, and industrial sensors, reducing system downtime by 20%.
**PLC automation:** Developed ladder logic solutions that increased system reliability by 30%.
**Signal conditioning:** Implemented 4-20mA sensor interfacing to improve data accuracy, noise immunity, and signal integrity.

experience.overview: **Overview:** Contributed to embedded firmware and satellite health monitoring systems.
highlights: **Health monitoring system:** Developed a satellite health monitoring system using COTS sensors and Embedded C, improving data accuracy by 35%.
**Flight firmware:** Designed firmware for BeliefSat-1 to support real-time image capture and wireless transmission via Arducam.
**Protocol debugging:** Implemented and debugged SPI, UART, and I2C communication for reliable sensor data acquisition.
